lines.text: स्त्रीजातकाघ्यायः
Female Horoscopy
यद्यत्फलं नरभवेऽक्षममङ्गनानां तत्तद्वदेत्पतिषु वा सकलं विधेयम्
तासां तु भर्तृमरणं निधने वपुस्तु लग्नेन्दुगं सुभगतास्तमये पतिश्च।। 1 ।।
Some of the results which a woman cannot enjoy by or for
herself, those must be attributed to her husband.
From the eighth house from her lagna, we know about the
death of her husband.
Her beauty or appearance is determined by her lagna and
by the sign occupied by her Moon.
Anything about her husband is to be derived from her
seventh house.
Notes: Everything said in the earlier chapters is applicable
to both men and women. But there are certain problems which
concern only women. These are now being detailed. These
include menstruel periods, puberty, conception and delivery.
There are also certain results which a woman shares with
her husband. Chapter 13.1 has given results which apply to
women. Rajayogas and the like are applicable to both husband
and wife.
युग्मेषु लग्नशशिनोः प्रकृतिस्थिता स्त्री
सच्छीलभूषणयुता शुभदृष्टयोश्च।
ओजस्थयोश्च मनुजाकृतिशीलयुक्ता
पापा च पापयुतवीक्षितयोर्गुणोना।। 2 ।।
